text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Blue, blue, blue! Blue will calm me!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Everything's wrong! My heart's been
pounding
like a drum and it just won't
calm down!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking at something blue to try and
calm
myself down, but it's not working at
all! And the
waiting is stressing me out!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...I'm eager? Oh, you're right! It's
because I want
to run so badly I can't
wait a second longer!
choice_data_list: 調子がいい証拠じゃないかな
choice_data_list_en: Isn't that proof you're in good shape?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Okay, in that case, I'll go with red for
passion
instead! Time to give it all I've
got! ☆
